main_text.p: quisitionem, seu concursum in actione producenda quo sibi laudem vel vituperium acquirit,(interim tamen absque impressione in ipsam actionem, ut interpolat Scholiastes in lib. Almawakef, ) ideóque AlAssharios iis accensent. Ut autem nominis cujus sæpius apud eos hac in controversia occurrit mentio, aliquam saltem habeamus notionem, illud Ebnol Kassai sic describentem audiamus الكسب [?] Al- هو الفعل المقضي الي اجتلاب نفع اودفع ضر Casb, actio est quæ dirigitur ad afferendam utilitatem, vel amovendam damnum, ideoque, inquit, non dicitur de actione Dei utpote qui nec sibi utilitatem nec damnum acquirit.

Jam vero inter Mohmammedanos tres præcipuè (ne minutiores differentias & distinctionum subtilitates sectemur) de decreto Dei, & de hominis circa actiones suas potentiâ, sententias reperiemus. prima est Motazalorum, de qua iis quæ jam dicta sunt addere liceat ex AlSharestanio statuere illos ان البارئ تعالي حكيم عادل لا يجوز ان يضاف اليه شر وظلم ولا يجوز ان يريد من العبد خلاف ما يامروه تعالي وينهاهم عنه شيا ثم يجازيهم عليه فالعبد هو الفاعل للخير والشر والايمان والكفر والطاعة والمعصية وهو المجازي علي فعله والرب تعالي اقدره علي ذلك كله وافعال العباد مصورة في الحركات والسكنات والاعتقادات والنظر

page.notes: The Arabic passage is set in a different, ornate Naskh-style type and was read with difficulty; it is transcribed as best as legible, with the first Arabic word of the block in the paragraph above and the rest in its own paragraph. The Arabic word after "Ebnol Kassai" ("الكسب") is doubtful. The Arabic lines at the start of the passage and within the block should be checked against the scan. Italic Latin words are the printed italic; "Mohmammedanos" and "Motazalorum" are set in a larger italic. No catchword, signature or margin notes are printed on this page.
